title: EnhanceM
description: EnhanceM is a Fabric mod for monsters that enhances them while providing players with more convenience, designed for those who prefer higher difficulty and greater challenges.
body:
# 🧟‍♂️ EnhanceM — The Monsters Are No Longer Standing Around

Tired of vanilla mobs just standing there? Skeletons mindlessly shooting arrows 🎯, the Ender Dragon fight feeling like a boring chore?
**EnhanceM** redesigns mob AI and combat mechanics to make Minecraft survival more challenging and strategic.

This isn't just a difficulty spike — it's a **complete overhaul of vanilla combat logic**: Skeletons now kite you, Spiders trap you with webs 🕸️, Zombies charge out of caves fully geared, and even the Ender Dragon brings its own minions. Of course, we also give you new survival tools: the life-saving "Divine Blessing" enchantment 🛡️, "Swift Boots" for quick escapes 👟, and the "Rebirth Pearl" to teleport back to world spawn 💎.

If you want a smarter and deadlier block world, give EnhanceM a try 🔥.

---

## ✨ Four Key Features

### 🧠 Mob AI Overhaul
- **Skeletons**: Adjust their distance from you — they retreat when you get too close, and chase when you move away 🏹.
- **Zombified Piglins**: Hit-and-run tactics, no more mindless face-tanking 💨.
- **Spiders**: On attack, chance to spawn a cobweb right under you, limiting movement 🕷️🕸️.
- Every mob has a different logic — positioning and awareness actually matter.

### ⚔️ Upgraded Enemy Gear
- Zombies spawn with random weapons from copper to netherite, sometimes with Fire Aspect 🔥 or Sharpness 🗡️.
- Piglins and Zombified Piglins wield guaranteed powerful weapons, some attacks also inflict slowness, knockback, and other crippling effects 😵.
- One misstep and you can get crowd-controlled — better gear and caution are required.

### 🐉 Ender Dragon: Now a Real Boss Fight
- Dragon HP ×3, fireball barrage frequency increased ☁️💨.
- Dragon fireballs have a chance to become "Ender Breath": hits randomly teleport you and aggro all nearby Endermen 🌀.
- At certain health thresholds, the Dragon summons "Ender Minions" wielding Netherite Axes — they teleport on hit and dodge ranged attacks 👥⚔️.

### ✨ New Items & QoL
- **Divine Blessing** 🛡️: Works like a built-in Totem of Undying; on trigger, the enchanted gear piece's durability is preserved at 5% — if already ≤5%, it breaks. Only obtainable via Bastion/Nether Fortress loot.
- **Swift Boots** 👟: Greatly increase sprint speed on land but double hunger drain while sprinting. Perfect for kiting and travelling.
- **Rebirth Pearl** 💎: After a 5-second channel (interrupted if damaged), teleports you to world spawn. Always consumed on use. Has a crafting recipe.
- Also: ×3 XP gain 🌟, and player death drops never despawn — no more lost gear 💀📦.

---

## 📋 Full Feature List

### 🧟 Mob AI & Behavior Changes
- **Skeletons** 🏹: Flee when too close, close in when too far.
- **Spiders** 🕷️: 50% chance to place a cobweb at the target's position when attacking.
- **Zombies** 🧟: Always spawn with a random weapon (copper 25%, iron 25%, gold 30%, diamond 15%, netherite 5%). If a sword, 25% chance of Fire Aspect II or Sharpness III.
- **Zombified Piglins** ⚔️: After attacking, back away to maintain a small gap instead of hugging you.

### ⚡ Combat Adjustments
- Zombie base movement speed increased to 0.35 (faster than walking, slightly slower than sprint), and attack range slightly extended.
- **Creepers** 💚 have two variants (50% each):
  - Standard: explosion inflicts Blindness, Nausea, and Slowness II for 5 seconds on nearby players 💨.
  - High-speed: doubled movement speed 💨💨.
- **Drowned** 🌊: Melee hits drain an extra 5 oxygen bubbles. Faster in water, slower on land.
- **Horses** 🐴: Double movement speed — now truly fast travel mounts.

### 🔥 Nether Mob Armament Upgrades
- **Piglins**:
  - Crossbow 🏹: arrows cause heavy knockback + brief slowness.
  - Sword 🗡️: guaranteed Fire Aspect II.
  - Trident 🔱: guaranteed Knockback III.
- **Piglin Brutes** 💪: melee attacks inflict Slowness I and force the player to crawl for 0.5 seconds.
- **Zombified Piglins**: Sword has Fire Aspect II 🔥, trident has Knockback III 💥.

### 🐉 Ender Dragon Battle Changes
- HP ×3 💚.
- Faster dragon fireball barrage ☁️.
- Fireballs have a 50% chance to become "Ender Breath": on impact, randomly teleport the player and aggro nearby Endermen 🌀👥.
- At every 20% HP lost, spawns 3 "Ender Minions" wielding Netherite Axes 🪓. They teleport on melee hit, cannot be hit by arrows, and prioritize the player who last attacked them.

### 🛠️ New Items & Enchantments
- **Divine Blessing** 🛡️: Activates like a Totem of Undying but preserves the armor piece at 5% durability; if already ≤5%, it breaks. Not from enchanting tables — find the book in Bastion Remnants or Nether Fortresses.
- **Swift Boots** 👟: Base stats equal Leather Boots. Land sprint speed ×1.7, but sprint hunger drain ×2. Found in bastion/fortress chests.
- **Rebirth Pearl** 💎: 5-second channel to teleport to world spawn, canceled by any damage. Always consumed. Crafted from amethyst clusters, ender pearl, warped stem, compass, and diamond 🔮🧭💠.

### 🎮 Gameplay Tweaks
- Player XP gain ×3 🌟 — enchanting becomes much smoother.
- Only player death drops never despawn 💀📦; mob drops follow vanilla rules.

---

## 📥 Installation

This mod requires **Fabric Loader** and **Fabric API**.
Refer to the [Fabric official documentation](https://docs.fabricmc.net/develop/getting-started/creating-a-project#setting-up) for installation steps.

*Your world just got deadlier — but so did your preparation 💪🌍*  - Enchanted Books have a **15%** chance to generate in Bastion Remnant (Treasure Room, Generic Rooms, Bridge, Hoglin Stables) and Nether Fortress chests.
  - Effect: Triggers a **Totem of Undying**-style lifesave. When activated, the enchanted gear piece is preserved down to **5% durability**. If durability is already **≤ 5%**, the item shatters and the effect does not trigger.
- **Swift Boots**:
  - Base stats equivalent to Leather Boots.
  - Sprinting speed on land boosted to **1.7x**, but hunger drain while sprinting is doubled.
  - Can accept normal boot enchantments.
  - Found in Bastion Remnant and Nether Fortress chests.
- **Rebirth Pearl**:
  - Plays a **5-second channeling animation** before teleporting you to the world spawn point.
  - Channel is **interrupted if you take damage**.
  - Consumed on use regardless of success.
  - **Crafting Recipe** (3×3):
    ```
    [Amethyst Cluster] [Compass]      [Amethyst Cluster]
    [Ender Pearl]      [Warped Stem] [Amethyst Cluster]
    [Amethyst Cluster] [Diamond]     [Amethyst Cluster]
    ```

### 🎮 Balance & Quality-of-Life
- **Triple XP Gain**: Player experience gain is multiplied by **3**.
- **Permanent Death Drops**: Only **player death drops** never despawn (no time limit); mob drops retain vanilla behavior.
